capabilities: Chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent from a side panel
Let the agent run bash, read and write files, and search the web in the vault
Reference the current note or @mention vault notes in prompts
Archive, resume, pin, and rename chat sessions with automatic context refill
Configure models, reasoning effort, tool execution mode, and security mode
extras: Security caveat: the agent's bash tool runs with user-level permissions and headless DSH has no file sandbox by default; persona rules only ask the agent to stay in the vault. Security mode offers read-only / workspace write / full access. Requires installing the DSH CLI and configuring DeepSeek credentials; a 'Run check' diagnostics button verifies the environment.
intentEvidence: designed based on an analysis of Enigmora/claudian; the key difference is that execution is pushed down
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an autonomous AI agent that can execute commands and modify vault files from a chat interface.

relations.evidence: This repo was designed based on an analysis of Enigmora/claudian
it calls DeepSeek Harness directly from the side panel

requires.name: DeepSeek API key or DSH credentials

summary: Chat panel that runs a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent in your vault, letting it execute bash, edit files, and search the web on your notes.
